```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(plotly)

# Extract county precinct files to a temporary directory and read the needed columns
txt_files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

gov_rep <- read_tsv(
  txt_files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(office = 12, candidate = 15, party = 16, votes = 19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate) |>
  mutate(
    vote_share = total_votes / sum(total_votes),
    candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes),
    # Tooltip text shown when hovering over a bar
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", candidate, "</b><br>",
      "Total Votes: ", comma(total_votes), "<br>",
      "Vote Share: ", percent(vote_share, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Build a ggplot with Florida's crimson-to-orange/gold state color palette
p <- gov_rep |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = candidate, fill = total_votes, text = hover_label)) +
  geom_col(color = "#B22234", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFB703", high = "#B22234", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#B22234"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

# Convert to an interactive plotly chart and embed the flag & panther images on the canvas
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFDF9",
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFDF9",
    images = list(
      list(
        source = "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f7/Flag_of_Florida.svg/330px-Flag_of_Florida.svg.png",
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        x = 0.98, y = 0.45,
        sizex = 0.22, sizey = 0.22,
        xanchor = "right", yanchor = "bottom",
        opacity = 0.9
      ),
      list(
        source = "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/37/Everglades_National_Park_Florida_Panther.jpg/330px-Everglades_National_Park_Florida_Panther.jpg",
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        x = 0.98, y = 0.12,
        sizex = 0.22, sizey = 0.22,
        xanchor = "right", yanchor = "bottom",
        opacity = 0.9
      )
    )
  )
```
